changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Migrate existing product data to mirror_products. For products that already have mirror_products records (matched by sku_id = mirror_code), update the mirror_products with product data. For products without mirror_products records, insert new records.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE mirror_products mp SET name = COALESCE(mp.name, p.name), currency = COALESCE(mp.currency, p.currency, 'VND'), metal_type = COALESCE(mp.metal_type, p.metal_type), metal_purity = COALESCE(mp.metal_purity, p.metal_purity), stone_type = COALESCE(mp.stone_type, p.stone_type), weight_grams = COALESCE(mp.weight_grams, p.weight_grams), dimensions = COALESCE(mp.dimensions, p.dimensions), image_url = COALESCE(mp.image_url, p.image_url), image_urls = COALESCE(mp.image_urls, p.image_urls), tags = COALESCE(mp.tags, p.tags), design_id = COALESCE(mp.design_id, p.design_id), designer_id = COALESCE(mp.designer_id, p.designer_id), featured = COALESCE(mp.featured, p.featured, false), is_active = COALESCE(mp.is_active, p.is_active, true), is_deleted = COALESCE(mp.is_deleted, p.is_deleted, false), stock_quantity = COALESCE(mp.stock_quantity, p.stock_quantity, mp.current_quantity, 0), min_stock_level = COALESCE(mp.min_stock_level, p.min_stock_level, mp.min_quantity, 1), price = COALESCE(mp.price, p.price), description = COALESCE(mp.description, p.description), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM products p WHERE mp.mirror_code = p.sku_id;

INSERT INTO mirror_products ( mirror_code, name, item_name, description, price, currency, metal_type, metal_purity, stone_type, weight_grams, dimensions, image_url, image_urls, tags, design_id, designer_id, status, published_at, fulfillment_completed_at, featured, is_active, is_deleted, current_quantity, stock_quantity, min_quantity, min_stock_level, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT DISTINCT ON (sku_id) p.sku_id as mirror_code, p.name, p.name as item_name, p.description, p.price, COALESCE(p.currency, 'VND') as currency, p.metal_type, p.metal_purity, p.stone_type, p.weight_grams, p.dimensions, p.image_url, p.image_urls, p.tags, p.design_id, p.designer_id, p.status, p.published_at, p.fulfillment_completed_at, COALESCE(p.featured, false) as featured, COALESCE(p.is_active, true) as is_active, COALESCE(p.is_deleted, false) as is_deleted, COALESCE(p.stock_quantity, 0) as current_quantity, COALESCE(p.stock_quantity, 0) as stock_quantity, COALESCE(p.min_stock_level, 1) as min_quantity, COALESCE(p.min_stock_level, 1) as min_stock_level, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM products p WHERE p.sku_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mirror_products mp WHERE mp.mirror_code = p.sku_id ) ORDER BY p.sku_id, p.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, p.id DESC;

rollback.comment: Data migration cannot be automatically rolled back
